policy: Initial-transfer JS and total CSS targets are release blockers. Total dist remains a regression ceiling until the legacy visual library is rights-audited and request-level physical-device evidence exists.

initialEntryJsGzip.note: M60: initial HTML module entry plus modulepreload closure. Save/store/routes load only after their user-visible boundary.

totalDistBytes.note: Large visual library is not an initial-transfer budget; request allowlists and physical-device telemetry remain separate gates.
